headlines.title_en: 58,100 yuan/sqm! Xiamen's first completed-housing-only land plot hits record-high floor price
headlines.summary_en: On September 24, Xiamen welcomed its first land auction after the "8·28" real estate policy, with both residential plots sold at the reserve price, for a total transaction amount of 4.195 billion yuan. Among them, the Huli District plot is the first residential plot in Xiamen and the first in Fujian Province to explicitly implement sales of completed homes after the new policy, with a composite floor price of 58,148 yuan per square meter, setting a new high for residential plot floor prices in Xiamen. headlines.title_en: Liuzhou: Going all out on the "123" agenda for maritime strength and open development
headlines.summary_en: According to a press conference on Liuzhou's efforts to do a good job in the "123" strategy of becoming a strong maritime power and promoting open development, and to promote high-quality development, Liuzhou's new energy vehicle production and sales both exceeded the one-million mark for the first time in 2025, with the local supporting rate for parts reaching 68%; LiuGong Group's overseas revenue accounted for more than 50%. The output value of strategic emerging industries accounted for 33.6% of industry, and cumulative new energy battery cell production capacity reached 57.5GWh. The Liujiang waterway was upgraded to a Class II waterway, allowing 2,000-ton vessels to reach the sea via inland waterways; the "Liuzhou-Qinzhou-ASEAN" rail-sea intermodal train was successfully launched. Approval was granted to establish the China (Liuzhou) Cross-Border E-Commerce Comprehensive Pilot Zone, and the 2025 industrial export delivery value reached 31.97 billion yuan. From an inland hinterland to a frontier of openness, Liuzhou is translating its momentum toward becoming a strong maritime power into tangible results in open development.

headlines.title: 泰国出口因人工智能和中国需求激增，创四年来最大增幅
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月25日讯，据外媒报道，泰国的出口以四年来最快的速度增长，受益于与全球人工智能热潮相关的电子产品，以及中国对泰国榴莲和山竹的需求激增。根据商务部周五的数据，8月份的出口同比增长24.3%，是56个月以来的最高增幅，7月份为21.6%。进口增长25.1%，低于上个月的36.7%。贸易逆差从7月份的36亿美元缩小至25亿美元。最新数据显示，商务部预测泰国今年的出口将创下新纪录。随着全球科技公司加大对人工智能基础设施的投资，占出口近三分之一的电子产品预计将继续成为主要驱动力。

headlines.title_en: Thailand's exports surge most in four years on AI and Chinese demand
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 25 - According to foreign media reports, Thailand's exports grew at the fastest pace in four years, benefiting from electronics related to the global AI boom and a surge in Chinese demand for Thai durians and mangosteens. According to Ministry of Commerce data on Friday, exports in August rose 24.3% year-on-year, the highest increase in 56 months, compared with 21.6% in July. Imports rose 25.1%, lower than 36.7% the previous month. The trade deficit narrowed to $2.5 billion from $3.6 billion in July. The latest data show that the Ministry of Commerce forecasts Thailand's exports will set a new record this year. As global tech companies increase investment in AI infrastructure, electronics, which account for nearly one-third of exports, are expected to remain a major driver.

headlines.title_zh: 美债暴跌威胁新兴市场套息交易，花旗选择撤退
headlines.summary_zh: 美国国债收益率飙升并触及数十年高位，正威胁到今年以来备受新兴市场投资者青睐的套息交易策略。 花旗集团已关闭其套息交易组合，该组合此前包括做多南非兰特、墨西哥比索、哥伦比亚比索和土耳其里拉，同时做空加元和瑞郎。花旗在周四发布的一份研报中表示，此举是由于强劲的美国采购经理人指数（PMI）报告、疲弱的5年期美债拍卖以及地缘政治消息共同推高了市场波动。 分析师写道：“我们过去已多次证明，套息交易通常在波动率高企和交易拥挤时期表现不佳。”
headlines.title_en: Plunge in US Treasuries threatens emerging-market carry trades, Citi chooses to retreat
headlines.summary_en: The surge in U.S. Treasury yields to multi-decade highs is threatening the carry trade strategy that has been favored by emerging market investors this year. Citigroup has closed its carry trade portfolio, which previously included long positions in the South African rand, Mexican peso, Colombian peso, and Turkish lira, while shorting the Canadian dollar and Swiss franc. Citigroup said in a research note released on Thursday that the move was due to a strong U.S. PMI report, a weak 5-year Treasury auction, and geopolitical news that together drove up market volatility. Analysts wrote: "We have proven many times in the past that carry trades usually perform poorly during periods of high volatility and crowded positioning."

headlines.title: 央行三季度例会内容发布 这个提法首次出现
headlines.summary: 【央行三季度例会内容发布 这个提法首次出现】与二季度例会相比，本次例会在表述上有几处调整：将“加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度”改为“加大逆周期调节力度”；新增“综合运用并适时调整货币政策工具”的提法，并强调要“推动货币政策操作框架改革完善”；同时，首次将“六张网”建设列为重点支持领域，并提出汇率市场要“防范市场‘羊群效应’和非理性预期的自我强化”。

headlines.title_en: PBOC releases Q3 meeting statement, with this formulation appearing for the first time
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC releases content of third-quarter regular meeting; this phrasing appears for the first time] Compared with the second-quarter meeting, this meeting made several adjustments in wording: "step up countercyclical and cross-cyclical adjustment" was changed to "step up countercyclical adjustment"; a new formulation was added to "comprehensively use and timely adjust monetary policy tools," and it emphasized the need to "promote reform and improvement of the monetary policy operating framework"; at the same time, for the first time, the construction of the "six networks" was listed as a key support area, and it proposed that the foreign exchange market should "guard against the market's 'herd effect' and the self-reinforcement of irrational expectations."

headlines.title: 日均240万人次 中秋、国庆假期民航旅客量将再创同期新高
headlines.summary: 民航局相关负责人表示，中秋、国庆假期也是民航旅客出行的高峰，环线游、出境游增速非常明显。假日出行还呈现出去程渐次达峰、回程集中抵离的特点。民航的旅客量有望再创历史同期新高。中国民航局副局长马兵介绍，整体来看，从9月25日到10月7日，全国民航预计运输旅客量3119万人次，日均240万人次，增长率3.6%。单日峰值有望突破260万人次，超过去年同期水平。

headlines.title_en: Averaging 2.4 million passenger trips per day, civil aviation passenger volume during the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays will hit a new high for the period
headlines.summary_en: A Civil Aviation Administration official said that the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays are also peak periods for civil aviation passenger travel, with notably rapid growth in round-trip and outbound travel. Holiday travel also shows the characteristics of outbound trips peaking gradually and return trips arriving and departing in a concentrated manner. Civil aviation passenger volume is expected to hit a new high for the same period in history. CAAC Deputy Administrator Ma Bing introduced that overall, from September 25 to October 7, civil aviation nationwide is expected to transport 31.19 million passengers, averaging 2.4 million per day, a growth rate of 3.6%. The single-day peak is expected to exceed 2.6 million passengers, surpassing the level of the same period last year.

headlines.title: 《亚伯拉罕协议》签署国举行自10月7日袭击事件以来的首次正式会议
headlines.summary: 据美国媒体CBS报道，周四上午，美国国务院官员参加了自2023年10月7日以来，亚伯拉罕协议签署国（美国、以色列、阿拉伯联合酋长国、巴林和摩洛哥）的首次正式会议。周四，哈萨克斯坦官员首次加入《亚伯拉罕协议》缔约国行列。哈萨克斯坦去年曾表示有兴趣加入该协议。美国代表团由国务院高级官员、政治事务副国务卿艾莉森·胡克率领。此次会议由总部位于美国的N7基金会主办，该基金会自2021年以来一直召集《亚伯拉罕协议》各国的多边会议。N7 基金会创始人、会议主席杰弗里·塔尔平斯说道，“下一阶段的重点是深化现有关系，并为各国合作寻找切实可行的机会。”

headlines.title_en: Signatories to the Abraham Accords hold first formal meeting since the October 7 attacks
headlines.summary_en: According to U.S. media outlet CBS, on Thursday morning, U.S. State Department officials participated in the first formal meeting since October 7, 2023, of the signatories to the Abraham Accords (the United States, Israel, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, and Morocco). On Thursday, Kazakh officials joined the ranks of parties to the Abraham Accords for the first time. Kazakhstan expressed interest in joining the accords last year. The U.S. delegation was led by senior State Department official and Under Secretary for Political Affairs Allison Hooker. The meeting was hosted by the U.S.-based N7 Foundation, which has convened multilateral meetings of Abraham Accords countries since 2021. N7 Foundation founder and conference chairman Jeffrey Talpins said, "The next phase focuses on deepening existing relationships and finding practical opportunities for cooperation among countries."
